name: Bite of My Own
source:
Life is as dull as ever with nothing to do and with no luck in finding a job, having no belief you'll be able to find any. But after months of waiting, you suddenly receive a call from an unknown number... You've got the job! You'll be starting Monday, but first, why not see Azriel's friends and world he lives in.

[From [url=https://rafaanimations.itch.io/bite-of-my-own]itch.io[/url]]
